visual_text: Older people after hip fracture surgery, insole sensors, one walk
Partial weight-bearing: 0 of 16 kept to it throughout
More than twice the permitted weight: 11
The other 5: none kept to it throughout (one managed briefly)
Most young adults with ankle fractures (14 of 18) kept to almost all of it. NICE: aim for full weight-bearing straight after surgery.
Kammerlander et al, J Bone Joint Surg Am 2018
alt_text: Icon array of 16 older people after hip fracture surgery. 11 icons marked with double chevrons put more than twice the permitted weight through the leg; the other 5, marked with a bar, did not keep to it throughout. None of 16 kept to partial weight-bearing. Young adults with ankle fractures mostly did (14 of 18).
